name: OIDC Sign-in
overview: Sign in to Shoko Server with an OpenID Connect provider such as Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia, Zitadel, Kanidm, Dex, Pocket ID or tinyauth.

releases.release_notes:
First public pre-release. Sign in to Shoko Server with an OpenID Connect provider instead of a Shoko password. This is an alpha: it has been tested against eight providers on a throwaway server, but not approved for protecting a real one.

It needs a Shoko Server build from v6.0.0-dev.529 or later (it is built against Shoko.Abstractions alpha.107). Install it by extracting the zip into `Shoko.CLI/plugins/Oidc/` and restarting Shoko. Setup and every setting are in the README.

**Changes:**
- Authorization code flow with PKCE, discovery, ID token validation and userinfo merging
- Sign-in button on the WebUI login page for WebUIs that read the `login-method` feature (draft ShokoAnime/Shoko-WebUI#1512)
- Link an existing Shoko account to a provider identity, or create accounts on first sign-in
- Map a provider group or role to Shoko admin on each sign-in
- Backchannel URL and a CA certificate file for providers Shoko cannot reach at their public address or that use a private CA
- Tested against Authentik, Keycloak, Authelia, Kanidm, Zitadel, Dex, Pocket ID and tinyauth; notes per provider are in `docs/providers.md`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Foowy/Shoko.Plugin.Oidc/commits/v0.1.0
